    Dimension counts for coefficient-quiver modules #

    For a coefficient quiver with nonzero coefficients and injective arrow moves (for instance a string module), the spaces of ExtBound and ExtBoundDual are coordinate subspaces, so their dimensions are numbers of positions:

    • E₀, E₀': positions over v;
    • K₀: positions over v with no incoming edge (the top at v);
    • K₀': positions over v with no outgoing edge (the socle at v);
    • Z_b: positions over src b with no incoming edge labelled by a forbidden predecessor of b;
    • Y_b: positions over tgt b with no outgoing edge labelled by a forbidden successor of b.

    Also dim Hom(S_v, M) = dim K₀' and dim Hom(M, S_v) = dim K₀ for every module.
